name: Kimi K3
tagline: Moonshot AI's open-weights 2.78T-parameter frontier MoE model
description: Kimi K3 is the open-weights release of Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, a 2.78-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model delivering frontier-level intelligence as open source. It positions itself as a direct rival to DeepSeek V4 in the open frontier-model race. The release pairs MoE scale with Moonshot's training and inference work, making state-of-the-art capability available beyond closed APIs.
highlights: 2.78 trillion parameters using a Mixture-of-Experts architecture
Frontier intelligence released under open weights
Positioned as a direct open competitor to DeepSeek V4
Sustained ~8.3k stars from the open-model community
curatorNote: The open-weights frontier is widening — a 2.78T MoE at this accessibility is a milestone worth tracking for anyone comparing against DeepSeek V4.
